data_access_label_id.description:
Required. The ID to use for the data access label, which will become the label's
display name and the final component of the label's resource name. The
maximum number of characters should be 63. Regex pattern is as per AIP:
https://google.aip.dev/122#resource-id-segments
data_access_label_id.rationale: Identifier for the data-access label resource. We do not constrain resource identifiers or naming conventions; naming-standard enforcement is not a security archetype.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description: Optional. A description of the data access label for a human reader.

instance.description: The unique identifier for the Chronicle instance, which is the same as the customer ID.
instance.rationale: References the parent Chronicle instance the resource belongs to. This is an identifier/reference to another resource and is not a security policy target.

location.description: The location of the resource. This is the geographical region where the Chronicle instance resides, such as "us" or "europe-west2".
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project the resource belongs to. This is an identifier/reference and is not a security policy target.

udm_query.description: A UDM query over event data.
udm_query.rationale: Free-form UDM query string defining which events the data-access label matches. This is an arbitrary embedded query document that a generic platform policy cannot meaningfully constrain, so it is out of scope.
